promo-5x4-crop.title: Etsy crops your first photo to 5:4 #shorts
promo-5x4-crop.description: You upload 2000x2000 as Etsy recommends. Search results show 570x456 - the middle 80%. Anything in the top or bottom 10% is gone. Full Etsy listing photo tutorial on the channel.

promo-mockup-trick.title: Product mockups in Canva, one drag #shorts
promo-mockup-trick.description: Elements, search "frame mockup", pick one with the placeholder icon, drag your design onto it. Then turn shadows on or it reads as fake. Full Etsy listing photo tutorial on the channel.
